description: When the Horn decision procedure accepts, the computed forward closure itself models the whole theory.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HornClauses.accepted_least_model.{u} {α : Type u} [DecidableEq α]
  (Γ : Finset (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HornClauses.Rule α))
  (h : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HornClauses.accepts Γ = true) :
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HornClauses.models Γ ↑(Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HornClauses.closure Γ)
